card.text: Red supergiant in Scorpius; its photosphere is not imaged here.

sources.label: SIMBAD
sources.quote: * alf Sco -- Red Supergiant; Spectral type M1.5Iab+B2Vn

introduction.text: Antares is the nearest red supergiant, 680 times wider than the Sun. Interferometers have measured its size and its atmosphere's motions; here its surface is a plain sphere.

sources.label: Ohnaka et al. 2013
sources.quote: We derive a limb-darkened disk diameter of 37.38+/-0.06 mas

shape.title: Sphere of the measured diameter
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
